# Phase 5B.4: Baselines and Model Skill Gate

## Model skill gate
- A model is valid only if its mean in-source MAE is lower than both the zero and composition-mean baselines on the same eval source and split.
- All reported models use the same test universe, unit (C/m²), total piezo stress tensor, and Frobenius metric.

## Notes
- The e3nn equivariant graph model was launched on the remote GPU host but did not complete within the available wall-time budget; its training code and a smoke-test forward pass are committed, but no e3nn metrics are reported here.
- The `mlp_invariant` and `structural_ridge` models are O(3)-invariant baselines on composition+structure features; they are reported as transparent reference models, not as full tensor-equivariant models.
- No reported model beats the zero baseline in absolute in-source MAE; therefore the valid-model gate is not passed and the benchmark proceeds as Data-Only Benchmark Go.
